rules: Applicant must be between 21 and 60 years of age.
Applicant must be an employee of a Private Limited company, Public Sector Undertaking (PSU), central, state, or local government body.
Self-employed individuals are strictly NOT eligible for this personal loan product and should consider a Business Loan instead.
keyRequirements: Age proof (PAN/Aadhaar/Passport/Driving License)
Employment identity proof or official company email/ID
sourceDocument: HDFC Bank Loan Approval & Eligibility Criteria - Section 1

rules: Minimum net monthly income must be at least ₹25,000 for salaried applicants.
Minimum 2 years of total work experience required.
Minimum 1 year of continuous experience in the current organization.
Income materially affects the maximum eligible loan amount.
Salary credits must be verified across salary slips and bank statement credit entries.
keyRequirements: Latest 3 months salary slips
Latest 6 months bank statement showing regular salary credits
Form 16 or Appointment/Experience Letter
sourceDocument: HDFC Bank Loan Approval & Eligibility Criteria - Section 1

rules: HDFC's current eligibility criteria requires a minimum CIBIL / credit score of 720.
Repayment history and existing loan EMIs are critical creditworthiness factors.
Interest rate and approved loan terms depend on CIBIL score, principal amount, and requested tenure.
Meeting published criteria does not guarantee sanction; final approval is subject to document verification and credit underwriting.
keyRequirements: Credit report / CIBIL score check >= 720
No 30+ DPD (Days Past Due) or write-offs in the last 12 months
sourceDocument: HDFC Bank Loan Approval & Eligibility Criteria - Section 1

rules: Applicant income and repayment capacity are primary factors in determining eligibility.
Applicant age and remaining working/earning years are evaluated to fix maximum loan tenure (up to 30 years or retirement age, typically 60-65 years).
Financial position, income stability, and quality of income must be verified.
Credit history and credit score (minimum 700+ recommended) must be satisfactory.
Existing debts, running EMIs, and credit card liabilities are factored into debt-burden calculations.
keyRequirements: Income tax returns (ITR) for last 2 years / Form 16
Salary slips for last 3-6 months
Bank statement for last 6 months
sourceDocument: HDFC Bank Loan Approval & Eligibility Criteria - Section 2

rules: Spouse, parent, or earning co-applicant income can be pooled to enhance loan eligibility.
Academic qualification, dependants, assets/liabilities, savings history, and continuity of occupation are assessed.
For self-employed applicants, business sustainability, 2+ years profit track record, and bank account cash flow are additionally assessed.
A field credit investigation (FI) may involve a physical or telephonic visit to home/office to validate submitted details.
keyRequirements: Co-applicant KYC and income documents
Business financials (P&L and Balance Sheet) for self-employed
sourceDocument: HDFC Bank Loan Approval & Eligibility Criteria - Section 2

rules: Property documents are mandatory part of approval; property valuation and legal title clearance must be completed before disbursement.
Sanction letter communicates approved in-principle amount, but final disbursement requires technical/legal report satisfaction.
Funding principle requires borrower's own contribution (down payment). Standard LTV ranges up to 75%-80% of property market valuation.
keyRequirements: Title deed, approved building plan, chain of ownership documents
Property valuation and legal search report
sourceDocument: HDFC Bank Loan Approval & Eligibility Criteria - Section 2

rules: Eligible borrower profiles include Salaried, Self-Employed individuals/professionals, and Non-Resident Indians (NRIs).
Age range is 21 to 65 years at maturity, resident Indian or eligible NRI.
Maximum tenure is up to 15 years (180 months).
A strong credit score and clean repayment track record are advised.
keyRequirements: Identity & address proofs
Income documents (Salary slips / ITRs / Audited financials)
Clear title property documents for collateral
sourceDocument: HDFC Bank Loan Approval & Eligibility Criteria - Section 3

rules: LTV limit is up to 65% of the assessed property market value for the primary LAP product.
For existing HDFC customers: existing loan principal outstanding plus new LAP should generally not exceed 60% of assessed market value.
For new customers: LAP should generally not exceed 50% of assessed market value.
Pledged property serves as primary security; interim security or additional collateral may be required in high-ticket cases.
Approvals remain at the sole discretion of the bank subject to title investigation and valuation.
keyRequirements: Registered sale deed, NOC from society, property tax receipts
Independent technical valuation by bank-empaneled valuer
sourceDocument: HDFC Bank Loan Approval & Eligibility Criteria - Section 3

rules: Nationality: Must be an Indian citizen.
Age: Minimum 21 years at application and not older than 65 years at loan maturity.
Eligible entities: Self-employed individuals, Sole Proprietors, Private Limited companies, Partnership firms, and LLPs engaged in manufacturing, trading, or services.
Minimum 3 years in current business and at least 5 years total business experience.
Business entity must have been profitable for the previous 2 consecutive financial years.
Minimum annual turnover of ₹40 lakh.
Minimum annual income as per ITR of ₹3 lakh.
keyRequirements: Business registration certificate (GST, Udyam, Shop & Establishment)
CA-certified or audited Balance Sheet and P&L statements for last 2 years
Latest 2 years ITR with computation of income
Last 6-12 months current bank account statement
GST returns (GSTR-3B / GSTR-1)
sourceDocument: HDFC Bank Loan Approval & Eligibility Criteria - Section 4

rules: Business loan amount can range up to ₹1 crore (100 lakh) depending on assessed financial eligibility and debt service capacity.
General tenure range is 12 to 48 months (1 to 4 years).
Identity and address proofs of promoters/directors must match application details exactly.
Banking cash flow and GST turnover match are inspected to verify business continuity.
Published thresholds do not guarantee approval; credit committee discretion applies.
keyRequirements: Promoter KYC (PAN, Aadhaar)
Entity PAN, MOA/AOA or Partnership deed
Banking statements showing genuine business credits
sourceDocument: HDFC Bank Loan Approval & Eligibility Criteria - Section 4

rules: Nationality: Must be an Indian citizen.
Age: 16 to 35 years for standard education loan.
A financial co-applicant is mandatory for all full-time courses (parent, legal guardian, spouse, or parent-in-law).
Admission must be secured through merit or recognized entrance examination.
Eligible programs include undergraduate, postgraduate degrees, and recognized diplomas from accredited institutions.
keyRequirements: Admission offer letter with fee structure breakdown
Academic marksheets (10th, 12th, Graduation)
Co-applicant income proofs (salary slips, bank statement, or ITR)
sourceDocument: HDFC Bank Loan Approval & Eligibility Criteria - Section 5

rules: Borrower and co-applicant must be Indian citizens.
Co-borrower must maintain an active bank account with cheque-writing facilities in an Indian bank.
Confirmed admission and I-20 / CAS / admission letter required before disbursement.
Foreign education loans are offered through HDFC Credila and subject to Credila underwriting and collateral norms.
Collateral/tangible security may be required for high loan amounts (typically above ₹7.5 - ₹15 lakh).
keyRequirements: Passport and Visa / Admission confirmation
Standardized test scores (GRE/GMAT/IELTS/TOEFL)
Collateral property documents if applicable
sourceDocument: HDFC Bank Loan Approval & Eligibility Criteria - Section 5

section: FOIR (Fixed Obligation to Income Ratio) & Repayment Capacity
rules: FOIR / Debt-to-Income calculation = (Existing Monthly EMIs + Proposed New Loan EMI) / Verified Net Monthly Income.
For Net Monthly Income < ₹50,000: Maximum permissible FOIR is 50%.
For Net Monthly Income ₹50,000 to ₹1,00,000: Maximum permissible FOIR is 55%.
For Net Monthly Income > ₹1,00,000: Maximum permissible FOIR is 65%.
Applications exceeding the maximum permissible FOIR cannot be approved for the requested amount and must be capped or declined.
keyRequirements: Accurate calculation of all existing debt obligations from bank statement debits / CIBIL
Accurate calculation of proposed EMI based on tenure and interest rate

rules: Identity consistency: Applicant name, DOB, and father's name on PAN card must match application details and Aadhaar card (Levenshtein similarity >= 85%).
Salary Variance: Variance between declared monthly income, payslip net salary, and bank statement salary credit must be <= 10%. Variance > 15% must be flagged for manual review.
Employer Verification: Employer name on salary slip must match Form 16 / Bank statement narration / application declaration.
Banking Health: Bank statement must not reflect cheque bounces / ECS returns (> 2 in 6 months is high risk). Minimum average monthly balance must be maintained.
Auditability: Every automated flag or exception must record the exact deterministic reason for audit trail.
Human Review: Final credit decision always rests with the human loan officer; GenAI provides decision support and grounded policy citations.
keyRequirements: PAN Card verification
Aadhaar / Address proof verification
Salary slip vs bank statement cross-matching
Form 16 / ITR tax computation cross-matching
